run_main: run the main function to continuously log Spot robot arm joint positions at 30Hz
run_get_arm_proprioception: run get_arm_proprioception on a Spot instance to retrieve current arm joint state data
run_spot_constructor: run the Spot constructor with a name string to initialize a robot connection
run_loginfo: run loginfo on a Spot instance to print arm joint positions and names to the console
run_rad2deg_conversion: run np.rad2deg to convert arm joint position values from radians to degrees
